name: hcapp_getEventMessages
description: Returns the messages of a run's chat thread, newest first, with author identity as flat columns (authorId, authorFirstName, authorImageUrl); HC5's hcapp_getEventMessages and hcapp_getEventMessages2 are merged into this one SP. A delta fetch (@sinceSequenceCount) returns only newer messages; the removed-id, reaction-update and reactionsAsOf rowsets follow every call. Every message row carries messageKind, canDelete (E9.F1.S11-S14, 2026-09-29), replyToMessageId, replyToText (NULL when deleted), replyToKind, replyToAuthor, replyToRemoved and reactions (E9.F1.S21/S22, 2026-09-30). Messages from a hasher the reader has blocked are hidden (E9.F1.S16). Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 60, @param NULL) — the token is the standard device-secret token, NOT bound to the event (the HC5 intent was never implemented). No permission gate: any authenticated user may read any run's thread.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret — @param NULL). Default NULL.

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: HC.Event.id of the run whose thread to read. NULL: errorCode 1260, errorType 12 (logged). The zero UUID is NOT normalised and simply matches nothing.

parameters.name: sinceSequenceCount
parameters.description: Delta fetch: only messages with a higher MessageSequenceCount; NULL = full fetch

parameters.name: reactionsSince
parameters.description: The last reactionsAsOf this client saw (E9.F1.S22). With it, the reader returns reactions changed since then on messages at or below sinceSequenceCount.

rowsets.name: AuthOrValidationError
rowsets.description: On auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) or NULL @eventId (errorCode 1260, errorType 12): the error detail alone, no envelope; the SP RETURNs. Runtime errors are logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown (THROW).

rowsets.name: Messages
rowsets.description: Live messages of the run thread the reader may see, ORDER BY createdAt DESC. Empty when nothing is newer than @sinceSequenceCount.

columns.name: id
columns.description: EventMessage.id uppercased via UPPER(). Returned as string, not typed UNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

columns.name: text
columns.description: EventMessage.MessageContent. NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: roomId
columns.description: EventMessage.PublicEventId. NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: createdAt
columns.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds computed via DATEDIFF_BIG(MILLISECOND, '1970-01-01', msg.createdAt).

columns.name: authorId
columns.description: Hasher.PublicHasherId uppercased via UPPER(). NOT NULL in base table.

columns.name: authorFirstName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName — persisted computed column, never NULL (falls back to '<no names provided>').

columns.name: authorImageUrl
columns.description: Hasher.Photo. NULL when hasher has no profile photo.

columns.name: canDelete
columns.description: 1 when the caller wrote it or may moderate this thread (HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat)

columns.name: replyToMessageId
columns.description: EventMessage.ReplyToMessageId, UPPER-cased; NULL when not a reply (E9.F1.S21).

columns.name: replyToText
columns.description: First 200 characters of the quoted message; NULL when not a reply or the original was removed.

columns.name: replyToRemoved
columns.description: 1 when the quoted message exists but was removed.

rowsets.name: RemovedMessageIds
rowsets.description: Every removed message in this thread (Removed = 1), so a client drops any it already drew — a delta by sequence number never sees a deletion (E9.F1.S13/S14). Find it by column name.

columns.name: removedId
columns.description: Id of a removed message (same case as the message ids)

rowsets.name: ReactionUpdates
rowsets.description: ALWAYS present (empty when @reactionsSince is NULL or nothing changed): { id, reactions } for live messages at or below @sinceSequenceCount whose ReactionsUpdatedAt is after @reactionsSince (E9.F1.S22).

rowsets.name: ReactionsAsOf
rowsets.description: One row { reactionsAsOf } — server time; pass back as @reactionsSince.

sideEffects: EXEC HC6.nonApi_mayModerateChat (event scope) to decide canDelete, line 98
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on NULL eventId (line 90) and from the CATCH block (lines 154-156, after ROLLBACK)

codeSmells.issue: id and authorId returned as uppercased strings, not typed UNIQUEIDENTIFIER
codeSmells.detail: UPPER(msg.id), UPPER(h.PublicHasherId) and UPPER(msg.ReplyToMessageId) (lines 101, 106, 112) return NVARCHAR in upper case, not UNIQUEIDENTIFIER; the app relies on lowerGuidsInPlace at the door (CLAUDE.md 'Ids are lowercase, everywhere').

breakingChanges: HC5 hcapp_getEventMessages 'author' column (nested JSON string via FOR JSON PATH) removed — replaced with three flat columns: authorId (UNIQUEIDENTIFIER), authorFirstName (DisplayName), authorImageUrl (Photo)
HC5 hcapp_getEventMessages2 SP removed — its flat-column behaviour is now the only rowset format returned by this SP
Error rowset shape changed: HC5 included debugMessage column; HC6 error rowset omits debugMessage and adds errorCode
Token is the standard device-secret token validated by HC6.ValidateAppAuth with @param NULL; HC5's intent to bind the token to the eventId was never implemented, so no caller depended on it.
